response.justification: The candidate is a strong full-stack and systems engineer with broad technical range (embedded, mobile, backend, DevOps) and 15+ years of experience, but the profile does not match a Director-level Principal Engineer role focused on AI strategy. There is no track record of AI/ML product leadership, cloud strategy work, or advising strategic enterprise customers, and only a few months of exposure to AI-agent tooling in the most recent role. Titles throughout the career (Senior/Staff Developer) also indicate IC execution rather than strategic, cross-org influence expected at this level.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering background spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Demonstrated ability to speak, teach, and mentor (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
Recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq
concerns: No evidence of AI/ML specialization, advanced AI degree, or recognized AI expertise
No experience advising strategic customers/partners or shaping cloud/AI product strategy at an organizational level
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff-level roles, not Director-level strategic leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/cloud strategy leadership experience
Broad technical versatility and communication/teaching skills
